Callout.Name: Vehicle Fire in a Tunnel
Callout.Message: Vehicle alight inside a tunnel, traffic still moving.
Callout.Advisory: Occupants out, smoke filling the tunnel.

Script.Line: It is alight inside and cars are still going past it.
The smoke is going along the roof. It is filling the tunnel.
Nobody has shut the tunnel at either end.

Lines.Approach: They are out of it but the smoke has nowhere to go and people are still driving in.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
